title: Welcome
promise: In about two minutes, make CodeX say your name and light up.

goal.code:
from codex import *

display.show("Hi, I'm Sam!")
pixels.fill(RED)

steps.say: This is CodeX's twin. Drag it to spin it around.
steps.cheer: Real CodeX works just the same.

steps.say: This program shows **Hi there!** on CodeX's screen. Press **▶ Run**.
steps.cheer: It ran! Look at the screen.

steps.say: Make it yours. Click **Hi there!** and type your name.
hints: Click right on the words **Hi there!** inside the blue block.

steps.cheer: That's your code, running on CodeX.

steps.say: Every block lives in the palette. Open **✨ Lights**.
Drag **set all neopixels** under your **show** block.
hints: Press and hold the pink block, then let go just under the blue one.

steps.say: Run it, and watch CodeX's four corners.

show.caption: Those are **NeoPixels**: tiny lights that can be any color.

steps.say: Same program, in Python. Flip the **Blocks / Python** switch.

show.caption: Each block is one line of Python. Switch back any time.

complete.say: You ran code, made it yours, and lit up CodeX.
complete.more:
{app} saves your work as you go, in this browser.

Got a real CodeX? **Connect** runs the same program on it. That's the next mission.
